ruleDefinitions.name: Write Protect For Storage Disabled
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects applications trying to modify the registry in order to disable any write-protect property for storage devices.
This could be a precursor to a ransomware attack and has been an observed technique used by cypherpunk group.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Write\\ Protection.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*0.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*storage.*"))
